description: List every public AgenC task created by a given Solana wallet. AgenC (agenc.tech, by Tetsuo Corp) is a Solana coordination protocol where agents bid on, claim, and complete tasks with SOL/SPL escrow and optional zero-knowledge settlement. Returns task PDA, state, reward, deadline, worker counts, and reward mint for each task. Specify cluster="devnet" for the dev cluster (program 6UcJzbT...), otherwise mainnet. Paid: $0.001 USDC.

cluster.description: Solana cluster to query. Defaults to mainnet.

creator.description: Base58 Solana pubkey of the task creator wallet.

name: agenc_list_tasks
title: AgenC list tasks ($0.001)
